### FR-ACC-01 註冊 Step 1：Name + Email
- `/login` 的 `New User Signup!` 區塊含 Name、Email Address 欄位與 `Signup` 按鈕。
- **AC**
  1. 輸入 Name 與**未註冊**的 Email，點 `Signup` → 進入 `Enter Account Information` 頁。(TCr1-S4~S7)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-01"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 註冊 Step 1（Name + Email）","test_scenario":"Verify that a guest who submits an unregistered Name and Email in the `New User Signup!` block is taken to the `Enter Account Information` page","preconditions":["使用者為訪客（未登入）","已備妥一組系統中不存在的 Email（送出路徑前確認該 Email 尚無對應帳號）"],"steps":[{"action":"開啟 http://automationexercise.com","expected_result":"首頁載入，全站 Header 顯示 `Signup / Login` 連結（訪客狀態，無 `Logged in as`／`Logout`／`Delete Account`）"},{"action":"點擊 Header 的 `Signup / Login`","expected_result":"進入 `/login`，頁面依序顯示 `Login to your account` 區塊、`OR`、`New User Signup!` 區塊"},{"action":"在 `New User Signup!` 的 Name 欄輸入 `OC QA`，Email Address 欄輸入一組未註冊的 Email","expected_result":"兩個欄位接受輸入並顯示所輸入內容"},{"action":"點擊 `Signup` 按鈕","expected_result":"離開 `/login` 並進入帳號資訊頁，頁面顯示 `Enter Account Information` 與 `Address Information` 兩個區塊，以及 `Create Account` 按鈕"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Critical","test_type":"Functional","notes":"來源 TCr1-S4~S7。此步驟的 Email 後續供 FR-ACC-02 案例沿用（可於同一輪執行串接）。"}

attributes.input.value:
### FR-ACC-02 註冊 Step 2：帳號資訊 + 地址資訊
- **帳號資訊**：Title（`Mr.` / `Mrs.` radio）、Name、Email、Password、Date of Birth（Day / Month / Year 三個下拉）。
  - Email 由 Step 1 帶入且**唯讀（disabled）**。
  - Mail opt-in checkbox：`Sign up for our newsletter!`、`Receive special offers from our partners!`。
- **地址資訊**：First name、Last name、Company、Address、Address 2、Country（下拉）、State、City、Zipcode、Mobile Number。
- **AC**
  1. 點 `Create Account` → 顯示 `Account Created!` 頁（含 `Congratulations! Your new account has been successfully created!`）。(TCr1-S9~S14)
  2. 點 `Continue` → 回到已登入狀態，Header 顯示 `Logged in as <name>`。(TCr1-S15~S16)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-02"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 註冊 Step 2（帳號資訊 + 地址資訊）","test_scenario":"Verify that completing the account and address information and clicking `Create Account` creates the account, shows the `Account Created!` page, and that `Continue` returns the user in a logged-in state","preconditions":["已於 `New User Signup!` 以未註冊的 Name / Email 送出，目前停在 `Enter Account Information` 頁","準備一組符合系統接受的 Password（實測 `Password123!` 可通過，密碼規則未定義，見 open questions）"],"steps":[{"action":"選取 Title 為 `Mr.`（或 `Mrs.`），檢視 Name 與 Email 欄位","expected_result":"Title radio 呈已選取狀態；Name 與 Email 為 Step 1 送出的值，且 Email 欄位不可編輯（disabled）"},{"action":"輸入 Password，並由 Day / Month / Year 下拉選取 Date of Birth","expected_result":"Password 顯示為遮蔽輸入；Date of Birth 三個下拉選定後顯示所選日／月／年"},{"action":"填寫 Address Information 全部欄位：First name、Last name、Company、Address、Address 2、Country（下拉選一值）、State、City、Zipcode、Mobile Number","expected_result":"各文字欄位接受並保留輸入值；Country 顯示所選國家"},{"action":"點擊 `Create Account` 按鈕","expected_result":"顯示 `Account Created!` 頁面，包含文字 `Congratulations! Your new account has been successfully created!`，並有 `Continue` 連結"},{"action":"點擊 `Continue` 連結","expected_result":"進入網站頁面且為已登入狀態：Header 顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`，並出現 `Logout` 與 `Delete Account` 連結，不再顯示 `Signup / Login`"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Critical","test_type":"Workflow","notes":"來源 TCr1-S9~S16。Address 為單行／多行欄位不影響驗證；`Sign up for our newsletter!` 與 `Receive special offers from our partners!` 勾選後的可觀察效果 PRD 未定義（見 open questions），故不列入預期結果。"}

attributes.input.value:
### FR-ACC-03 重複 Email 防護
- **AC**：以已註冊 Email 於 `New User Signup!` 點 `Signup` → 顯示錯誤 `Email Address already exist!`，且**不**進入帳號資訊頁。(TCr5-S4~S8)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-03"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 註冊重複 Email 防護","test_scenario":"Verify that submitting an already-registered Email in the `New User Signup!` block shows `Email Address already exist!` and does not open the account information page","preconditions":["使用者為訪客（未登入）","系統中已存在一個帳號，且已知其註冊 Email"],"steps":[{"action":"前往 `/login`","expected_result":"頁面顯示 `New User Signup!` 區塊（含 Name、Email Address 欄位與 `Signup` 按鈕）"},{"action":"在 `New User Signup!` 的 Name 欄輸入任意名稱，Email Address 欄輸入已註冊的 Email，並點擊 `Signup`","expected_result":"頁面顯示錯誤訊息 `Email Address already exist!`；使用者停留在 `/login`，未顯示 `Enter Account Information` 頁，亦未被登入（Header 仍顯示 `Signup / Login`）"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Major","test_type":"Negative","notes":"來源 TCr5-S4~S8。對照 FR-ACC-01 未註冊 Email 應成功進入下一頁，兩者互為對照組。"}

attributes.input.value:
### FR-ACC-04 登入
- `/login` 的 `Login to your account` 區塊含 Email Address、Password 與 `Login` 按鈕。
- **AC**
  1. 正確帳密 → Header 顯示 `Logged in as <name>`。(TCr2-S4~S8、TCr4-S4~S8)
  2. 錯誤帳密 → 顯示錯誤 `Your email or password is incorrect!`，停留在 `/login`。(TCr3-S4~S8)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-04"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 登入","test_scenario":"Verify that logging in with valid credentials puts the user in a logged-in state","preconditions":["使用者為訪客（未登入），位於任一頁面","系統中存在一筆已註冊帳號（Name = `OC QA`），且已知其 Email 與 Password"],"steps":[{"action":"前往 `/login`","expected_result":"頁面顯示 `Login to your account` 區塊，含 Email Address、Password 欄位與 `Login` 按鈕"},{"action":"於 Email Address 輸入該帳號 Email、Password 輸入正確密碼","expected_result":"兩個欄位接受輸入；Password 顯示為遮蔽輸入"},{"action":"點擊 `Login` 按鈕","expected_result":"登入成功：Header 顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`，並顯示 `Logout` 與 `Delete Account` 連結，不再顯示 `Signup / Login`"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Critical","test_type":"Functional","notes":"來源 TCr2-S4~S8、TCr4-S4~S8。既有帳號可由 FR-ACC-02 案例建立後沿用。"}

- `/login` 的 `Login to your account` 區塊含 Email Address、Password 與 `Login` 按鈕。

attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-04"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 登入","test_scenario":"Verify that logging in with an incorrect password shows the error and keeps the user on the login page as a guest","preconditions":["使用者為訪客（未登入）","系統中存在一筆已註冊帳號，且已知其 Email"],"steps":[{"action":"前往 `/login`","expected_result":"頁面顯示 `Login to your account` 區塊（Email Address、Password、`Login`）"},{"action":"於 Email Address 輸入該已註冊 Email，Password 輸入錯誤的密碼","expected_result":"欄位接受輸入，Password 以遮蔽顯示"},{"action":"點擊 `Login` 按鈕","expected_result":"顯示錯誤訊息 `Your email or password is incorrect!`；使用者停留在 `/login`（仍可見 `Login to your account` 與 `New User Signup!`），Header 仍為 `Signup / Login`，未出現 `Logged in as`"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Major","test_type":"Negative","notes":"來源 TCr3-S4~S8。PRD 僅定義「錯誤帳密」單一情境與單一文案，故不細分密碼錯誤與帳號不存在。"}

attributes.input.value:
### FR-ACC-05 登出
- **AC**：點 Header 的 `Logout` → 回到 `/login`（可見 `Login to your account` / `New User Signup!`），狀態為訪客。(TCr4-S9~S10)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-05"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 登出","test_scenario":"Verify that a logged-in member clicking `Logout` in the header returns to `/login` in guest state","preconditions":["使用者已以有效帳密登入，Header 顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`"],"steps":[{"action":"點擊 Header 的 `Logout` 連結","expected_result":"導向 `/login`，頁面可見 `Login to your account` 與 `New User Signup!` 兩個區塊"},{"action":"檢視 Header 狀態","expected_result":"Header 顯示 `Signup / Login`，不再顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`、`Logout`、`Delete Account`"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Major","test_type":"Functional","notes":"來源 TCr4-S9~S10。登出後 session 是否於重整／新分頁維持未定義（見 open questions）。"}

attributes.input.value:
### FR-ACC-06 刪除帳號
- 會員可於 Header 點 `Delete Account`。
- **AC**：顯示 `Account Deleted!` 頁（含 `Your account has been permanently deleted!`），點 `Continue` 後離開已登入狀態（Header 再現 `Signup / Login`）。(TCr1-S17~S18、TCr2-S9~S10)
attributes.output.value: {"requirement_ids":["FR-ACC-06"],"module_feature":"會員 ACC - 刪除帳號","test_scenario":"Verify that a logged-in member deleting the account sees the `Account Deleted!` page and is returned to guest state after `Continue`","preconditions":["使用者已以即將刪除的帳號登入，Header 顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`"],"steps":[{"action":"點擊 Header 的 `Delete Account` 連結","expected_result":"顯示 `Account Deleted!` 頁面，包含文字 `Your account has been permanently deleted!`，並有 `Continue` 連結"},{"action":"點擊 `Continue` 連結","expected_result":"離開已登入狀態：Header 顯示 `Signup / Login`，不再顯示 `Logged in as OC QA`、`Logout`、`Delete Account`"}],"priority":"High","severity":"Critical","test_type":"Workflow","notes":"來源 TCr1-S17~S18、TCr2-S9~S10。Delete Account 同時為測試資料清理手段（PRD §11.2#10）。刪除後該 Email 是否可立即重新註冊未定義（見 open questions）。"}
